verdict.rationale: The evidence describes separate data types (balances, ownership, transactions), use-case-specific integrations, and per-data-type refresh webhooks. None of it documents how a developer requests only specific scopes, how consent is scoped per product, or any data-minimization controls. Having distinct data products is adjacent to granular consent but does not show the capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I request only the data scopes I need — product-scoped consents and documented data-minimization controls, not an all-or-nothing grant
